subject: TurnKey competitive match + integration feasibility
messages:
From: Greg Chan <greg@turnkey.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@turnkey.ai>, Anika Bose <anika@turnkey.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up + ask for price parity

Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement ran a quick TCO model and asked whether Redwood can provide a price-match or structured onramp to justify moving from their incumbent. Key points from their side: 

- Current vendor: VectorCloud (contract through 2028)
- Approx monthly usage: ~120M tokens, mostly generation, bursty at month end
- Current blended price: $0.0016/token (net after credits)
- They are asking for a 12-month runway at parity or a staged credit schedule to offset migration cost

Attached is the RFP spec + current SOW (TurnKey_RFP_Response_v2.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can match economics or provide a migration credit structure and what the on-prem/runtime packaging differences would be? They also care about egress and connection SLAs.

Happy to hop on a quick call this week.

—Greg
Greg Chan
Head of Strategic Partnerships
TurnKey AI

Attachment: TurnKey_RFP_Response_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Greg Chan <greg@turnkey.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up + ask for price parity

Greg —

Appreciate the context and the RFP. Quick answers up front: 

- We can put together a parity-style offer; need to validate the exact token mix and runtime (hosted vs dedicated) before finalizing numbers.
- Typical lever: 6–12 month migration credit bucket + a committed seat/throughput discount for a 12–24 month term.
- We will surface a technical onboarding workbook (onboard-playbook.xlsx) that maps integration effort to expected cutover window and data egress considerations.

Jonas — looping you in for pricing construction and whether we can fold in an SLA/uplift for egress during migration.

Greg — can you share a representative 30-day token trace (anonymized) so we can simulate batching benefits? Also: are there any exclusive add-ons (vector DB or fine-tuning) that the incumbent is bundling?

Talk soon —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: onboard-playbook.xlsx (Excel workbook, 320KB)
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, Greg Chan <greg@turnkey.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up + ask for price parity

Greg / Hannah —

Thanks — I ran a quick back-of-envelope given the inputs: assuming 120M tokens/month and a hosted deployment, the raw list rate would be ~ $0.0020/token for our high-capacity model tier. Practical commercial options to bridge to VectorCloud's $0.0016/token: 

1) 12-month migration credit: $110k month 1–3, $55k month 4–6, then standard billing (credit applied against usage).
2) 12-month term with 15% committed volume discount + 3-month onboarding credit equal to 20% of expected first-quarter spend.
3) Dedicated pool offer: slightly higher baseline but we can guarantee 30% better unit economics at 6+ GPUs reserved for consistent throughput — requires 60-day lead for capacity.

Non-price tradeoffs to highlight to procurement: 
- Prefix/KV caching and continuous batching can reduce effective tokens by ~8–12% depending on prompt reuse.
- We offer free parallelized migration runs that reduce go-live risk (we recommend a 4–6 week parallel validation).

Marissa — can you confirm whether we can provide a one-time egress credit to offset data transfer costs for annual/enterprise deals?

Jonas Weber
Senior Commercial Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: cost-comparison-sheet.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Greg Chan <greg@turnkey.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@turnkey.ai>, Anika Bose <anika@turnkey.ai>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up + ask for price parity

Hannah / Jonas —

Thanks for the thoughtful options. Procurement has three asks they want addressed before moving to an internal recommendation: 

- A clear 12-month blended net price that lands at or below $0.0016/token (including credits) — they want a single headline number we can use in our procurement memo.
- A minimal break-fix SLA during the first 90 days of cutover (we can accept tiered credits).
- A timeline showing parallel validation and final cutover that does not exceed 10 weeks from contract signature.

Of the options you proposed, option (2) looks most viable if the blended headline number checks out. They confirmed there are no exclusive add-ons — VectorCloud had bundled a managed vector DB, but TurnKey is willing to separate that procurement if pricing is right.

If you can send a one-pager with the blended 12-month net headline number and exact credit structure (we'll share the 30-day trace after a quick NDA), we can get procurement sign-off fast.

Greg

On Thu, Mar 25, 2027 at 08:36, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Sounds good — will draft the one-pager and include a concrete blended rate.
> Hannah
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Greg Chan <greg@turnkey.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up + ask for price parity

Greg —

Attached is the one-pager summary (see attachments in thread). Headline blended net for 12 months assuming the usage profile you shared: $0.00155/token effective, structured as follows: 

- Base list rate: $0.0020/token for hosted high-capacity model tier.
- Commitment: 12-month minimum with expected monthly volume of 120M tokens.
- Upfront migration credit: $330k applied month 1–3 ($110k/mo) to offset cutover and integration work.
- Ongoing committed discount: 15% off list from month 4–12.
- One-time egress credit: up to $25k to offset data transfer costs during migration.
- SLA: 99.9% availability for the first 90 days; 0.5% service credit per 1% below (capped at 10%).
- Timeline: parallel validation window 4–6 weeks; total cutover target 10 weeks post-signature.

If TurnKey signs an annual committed contract and agrees to a standard migration checklist, we can hold this structure for 10 business days. Please share the anonymized 30-day trace after your privacy NDA and we'll run a final simulation to confirm caching/batching uplift and the final blended figure.

Next steps (recommended):
- Greg: confirm NDA and share trace by Wed 3/31
- Jonas/Marissa: prepare draft commercial term sheet (track any margin floor implications)
- Hannah: schedule executive skit between both teams for 4/1 to review SLA and cutover plan

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
